merge.name: Kissing Dishes
merge.howTo: Swipe to slide the dishes: two of a kind kiss and turn into a bigger dish. Grow a bunch of greens into a whole festive table.

slice.name: Salad Panic
slice.howTo: Swipe to slice the panicking veggies before they fall. Don't break grandma's teapot. The golden pomegranate scores ×10.

runner.name: Waiter Run
runner.howTo: Tap to jump, tap again in the air to jump higher. Swipe down to slide under awnings and signs. Collect the coffee cups.

fighter.name: Kitchen Clash
fighter.howTo: The arrows walk, jump and raise a pot lid (down). The round buttons swing the spoon, swing the pan and throw a tomato; on a keyboard, Z, X and C. Win two rounds to become head chef.

platformer.name: Café Cat
platformer.howTo: The arrows walk, the big button or Space jumps. Grab the fish and sausages, stomp the mice, dodge the hot burners and the chef's broom, and steal his plate of fish.
